items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Oscar Moore' and the interviewee responds with a disjointed comment about a recording session ('it could have been me... with this real fine chick') that does not establish a personal or professional connection with Oscar Moore.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, I forgot about that, he's a wonderful alto player. O'Neal Gerald. O'Neal Gerald. Okay.

And, and Oscar Moore. A drummer. A drummer. Oscar Moore. Yeah. A drummer. A drummer. Oscar Moore. Yeah, this was December 4th, 1953. Was that his first recording? No, first recording for Atlantic but his first for Atlantic.
Because he did one thing, I think that was Atlantic, it could have been me, it should have been me with this real fine chick.
